## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` should be fixed before merge. It tells users to leave out "shall", but deployments that set the validator option `require_shall` still reject any criterion without that word.

## Changes
The pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` to ask for direct action bullets without "shall", and rewords `BULLET_HINT` to show the literal `- ` prefix. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make CRITERION_HINT match the require_shall setting — With `require_shall=True`, a user who follows the new hint and writes `- Save the result` is rejected, because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` (app/criteria.py:7-8). `tests/test_criteria.py:21` asserts that rejection, and the PR body says the option is kept. — Users on deployments with `require_shall: true` are told to write criteria that the validator then rejects. — Fix: Choose the hint wording based on `require_shall`, or keep a hint that does not mention "shall".
